narration: Sixty percent of Americans will die without a will — and the government's plan for your stuff is a lot more expensive than you think.
visual: Dark background, person silhouette with large red X over a document/will icon, '60%' stat in blue text springs in, subtitle fades below

narration: Without a will, everything you own gets frozen inside a court process called probate. Your family can't touch your house or your accounts while the lawyers get paid.
visual: Light background, courthouse SVG with columns and pediment, 'PROBATE' text appears in red, padlock icon over a house, 'your family can't touch anything' label

narration: The average probate case drags on for eighteen months. That's a year and a half your family spends in legal limbo, grieving and paying attorney fees at the same time.
visual: Dark background, 3x6 calendar grid — 18 cells light up one by one in blue, '18 MONTHS' counter appears at bottom, 'of legal limbo' subtitle

narration: On a six-hundred-thousand dollar estate — one house and some savings — probate fees can hit forty-seven thousand dollars. That's the government taking their cut just for doing paperwork.
visual: Light background, house SVG labeled $600,000, arrow pointing down to red counter animating up to $47,000, money-flying-away effect

narration: Here's the wild part: a basic will takes thirty minutes online and costs around a hundred bucks. That hundred-dollar document just saved your family forty-seven thousand dollars and a year and a half of heartache.
visual: Dark background, two comparison boxes side by side — green box: '$100 / A Basic Will / 30 min online' vs red box: '$47K / Probate Fees / 18 months of hell'

narration: Don't let the government write your final chapter. Make a will this week — your family is counting on you more than they even know.
visual: Light background, three-person family silhouette with blue accent child, animated blue checkmark drawing in, 'Make Your Will This Week' CTA text
